title: Intraday vs end-of-day drawdown
caption: Rule breakdown: intraday trailing vs end-of-day (EOD) drawdown, and what Tradever uses. #tradever #propfirm #fundedtrader #futurestrading #ad @tradeverfunding @laythbanks

slides.sub: Know which one your account uses.

slides.text: Intraday trailing drawdown follows your *open profit*, tick by tick.
slides.sub: A winner that pulls back can still tighten your limit.

slides.text: End-of-day drawdown updates once, at the *close*.
slides.sub: Swings during the session don't move it.
Always read the full rules for your account.
